$comment: Single source of truth for Marsad's taxonomy. The app reads names/colors; the daily digest reads scope, keywords and sources to know exactly what to look for in each section.

hint.en: Claude Code, the API, new models and everything from Anthropic
hint.ar: تحديثات Claude Code والـ API والموديلات وكل منتجات Anthropic

sections.scope: Claude Code releases and features, Claude apps, Anthropic API/SDK/Agent SDK changes, new Claude models, docs and engineering posts from Anthropic.

hint.en: Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Cline and more
hint.ar: Cursor وCodex وGemini CLI وOpenCode وCline وغيرهم

sections.scope: AI coding agents, AI IDEs and editor extensions other than Claude Code: new tools, major releases, new capabilities, comparisons worth reading.

hint.en: Ready-made skills, plugins, subagents and workflows for agents
hint.ar: skills وplugins وsubagents وworkflows جاهزة للـ agents

sections.scope: Agent Skills (SKILL.md), Claude Code plugins and marketplaces, subagent collections, slash-command packs, CLAUDE.md templates and agent workflow frameworks.

hint.en: New MCP servers, connectors and protocol changes
hint.ar: MCP servers جديدة، وconnectors، وتغييرات البروتوكول

sections.scope: New or notable MCP servers (especially official ones from vendors), MCP spec and SDK changes, MCP registries and gateways.

hint.en: New models, pricing and API changes, RAG and local models
hint.ar: موديلات جديدة، وتغييرات الأسعار والـ APIs، وRAG، والموديلات المحلية

sections.scope: New models from any lab, API and pricing changes, SDKs and agent frameworks, RAG/embeddings/evals tooling, local models and inference.

hint.en: Backend frameworks and tools in any language, APIs, auth and queues
hint.ar: frameworks وأدوات الـ backend بأي لغة، والـ APIs والـ auth والـ queues

sections.scope: Backend frameworks and libraries (Node, Python, Go, etc.), API design, auth, queues, caching, background jobs — especially AI-assisted backend tooling.

hint.en: Laravel releases and packages, plus AI tooling for PHP
hint.ar: إصدارات Laravel وباكدجاتها، وأدوات الـ AI لـ PHP

sections.scope: Laravel and PHP releases, notable packages, Laravel AI SDK/Boost/MCP, Filament/Livewire, PHP AI libraries and tutorials worth reading.

hint.en: React, Next, Vue, CSS, UI libraries and design-to-code
hint.ar: React وNext وVue وCSS، ومكتبات الـ UI، والتحويل من تصميم لكود

sections.scope: Frontend frameworks and releases, CSS, component libraries, UI kits, design-to-code and AI UI generation tools, frontend skills for agents.

hint.en: Postgres, MySQL, Redis, ORMs and vector databases
hint.ar: Postgres وMySQL وRedis، والـ ORMs، والـ vector databases

sections.scope: Databases, ORMs, migrations, query tooling, vector databases, data pipelines and AI-for-SQL tools.

hint.en: System design, patterns, spec-driven development and docs
hint.ar: تصميم الأنظمة والـ patterns وspec-driven development والتوثيق

sections.scope: Software architecture and system design, design patterns, spec-driven development, ADRs and documentation tooling, AI-assisted architecture and code-understanding tools.

hint.en: Playwright, test generation and AI code review
hint.ar: Playwright، وتوليد التيستات، والـ code review بالـ AI

sections.scope: Test frameworks, E2E/browser testing, AI test generation, AI code review bots, QA automation.

hint.en: Docker, CI/CD, servers, self-hosting and monitoring
hint.ar: Docker وCI/CD والسيرفرات والـ self-hosting والمراقبة

sections.scope: Containers, CI/CD, self-hosting platforms, servers and Linux tooling, observability, cloud and deployment platforms, AI for ops.

hint.en: Securing code and agents, secrets, and major vulnerabilities
hint.ar: أمان الكود والـ agents، والأسرار، وثغرات مهمة

sections.scope: Application and supply-chain security, secret scanning, SAST, security of AI agents and MCP (prompt injection, permissions), critical vulnerabilities in common stacks.

hint.en: n8n, autonomous agents, browser and task automation
hint.ar: n8n، والـ agents اللي بتشتغل لوحدها، وأتمتة البراوزر والمهام

sections.scope: Workflow automation platforms, multi-agent orchestration, background/scheduled agents, browser automation and scraping for agents.

hint.en: The terminal, git, CLIs and tools that boost your productivity
hint.ar: الترمينال وgit والـ CLI وأدوات تزوّد إنتاجيتك

sections.scope: Terminal apps, shells, git tools, CLI utilities, editors and productivity tools for developers.

hint.en: Video generation and editing, audio, voices and dubbing
hint.ar: توليد وتعديل الفيديو، والمونتاج، والأصوات والدبلجة

sections.scope: AI video generation and editing, editing software features, voice/TTS/dubbing, music and sound effects generation.

hint.en: Image generation, UI/UX tools and branding
hint.ar: توليد الصور، وأدوات الـ UI/UX، والبراندنج

sections.scope: Image generation models and tools, UI/UX design tools with AI, branding and vector tools.
